role: Backend/deployment name resolver, not a generic string split or JSON parser. Runtime literals describe the argument as the -epicapp override and report using a default backend when no override is passed. The delegate construction containing this callback remains a candidate; its installation in the live discovery delegate is unproven.
signature: Windows x64: rcx points to an FString input (pointer and int32 length read at +0/+8); rdx and r8 point to mutable FString outputs. It copies the input into an owned temporary and returns a boolean in al. The candidate callback passes its second argument and two zeroed local FString objects. The semantic names and subsequent consumers of the two outputs remain unresolved.
normalization: 0x1422cb524-0x1422cb58d compares the copied input against Fortnite with 0x142bcf780, a UTF-16 comparison with case folding for ASCII. Unless the whole string compares equal to Fortnite it calls 0x142bb14c0, which checks and removes a matching Fortnite prefix using case-insensitive mode. Thus a nonmatching prefix is preserved; exactly Fortnite is retained.
empty_input: If normalized FString length <=1, 0x1422cb5a0 onward derives a default using additional runtime/build context. The path contains platform/environment and branch-dependent selections and logs the chosen default. Concrete literals include Prod, Stage, GameDev, UE4 and branch names; the complete choice rules are not established here. Nonempty input takes the override path at 0x1422cc497 and proceeds to mapping.
proven_mapping: After case-insensitive comparison of normalized name to CI at 0x1422cc3bd-0x1422cc444, the resolver assigns CI to the third-argument FString at 0x1422cc44a-0x1422cc492. At 0x1422d00a7-0x1422d019c the CI output case assigns CI to the second-argument FString and returns true. This establishes CI => (CI, CI, true), including a FortniteCI spelling after prefix removal.
failure_path: At 0x1422d2a38-0x1422d2a9b a failure branch clears both output FStrings and returns false. The full conditions reaching that branch are not established by this bounded inspection.
remaining: The resolver contains a roughly 30 KB chain ending at 0x1422d2ac9, with many deployment names and two-stage mappings. Its complete mapping, default decision tree, all return conditions and callback use of the outputs remain unlifted. Next trace the callback after the boolean test at 0x1427da188 through protected continuation 0x1495a12e4 and recover state writes and config sources; do not infer endpoint or live binding from this helper.
validation: Read-only bounded raw-image GNU objdump and UTF-16 literal reads, plus narrow inspection of comparison and prefix-removal callees. No Ghidra, heap dereference, native edits, build, tests or runtime claim.
